<script>
  document.querySelector('body').addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    var item_name_element = e.target.closest('.c2c-products__list > li').querySelector('.c2c-product-card__description');
    var item_name = item_name_element ? item_name_element.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, '-') : '';

    var price_element = e.target.closest('.c2c-products__list > li').querySelector('[data-cy="product-price"]');
    var price_raw = price_element ? price_element.textContent.trim() : '';
    var priceClean = price_raw.replace(/R\$|\s/g, '').replace(',', '.');
    var price = parseFloat(priceClean)


    dataLayer.push({
        event: 'ga4_add_to_cart',
        ecommerce: {
            items: [
                {
                    'item_id': undefined,
                    'item_name': item_name,
                    'item_category': {{[VAR - Verticalizada] category}},
                    'item_category2': 'imoveis',
                    'item_category3': item_name,
                    'item_variant': 1,
                    'price': price,
                    'quantity':'1',
                    'discount': {{[VAR] Tratamento discount 'undefined'}}
                    }
                ]
            }
        });
  });
</script>

<script>

var cookieName = "userID";
var cookieValue = {{[VAR] UserID Cookie Validation}};
var expirationTime = 5184000; // Two months in seconds
expirationTime = expirationTime * 1000; // Converts expirationtime to milliseconds
var date = new Date();
var dateTimeNow = date.getTime();

date.setTime(dateTimeNow + expirationTime); // Sets expiration time (Time now + one month)
var date = date.toUTCString(); // Converts milliseconds to UTC time string
  if(cookieValue){
    document.cookie = cookieName+"="+cookieValue+"; SameSite=None; Secure; expires="+date+"; path=/; domain=." + location.hostname.replace(/^www\./i, ""); // Sets cookie for all subdomains
  }
</script>
